name: 60 degree overhang variant
desc: The deck plate and lip shell with every round reworked for a 60 degree print overhang (the tub's back, the step to the decks, the face rounds).

name: Deck plate and lip
desc: Each deck's plate runs on under the step, and one lip at the foot of the top piece's step drops into a groove across the deck. The teeth and the wedge are gone.

name: Interlocking joints, lowered seam
desc: The joints interlock (a 3 mm tongue, keys, corner posts, grip ribs), the seam drops onto the back's round, and the side joint laps.

name: Side screws inward
desc: The four side screws move inside the top piece, so the shoulders go; the speaker, J4 and USB-C follow the board. Every printed part is manifold.

name: Cell in the board
desc: The cell sits in a hole cut through a 72.4 mm board, with the speaker on the board's top: the case drops to 9.55 mm at the screen.

name: 2.4 in panel, new shell
desc: A 133 mm case for the 2.4 in panel, built upside down: a top piece and two decks over the tub, the board re-placed and re-routed to fit.

name: Speaker out the side wall
desc: The last 3.5 in layout: the speaker on a plug-in J4 fires out the side wall, the silicone pads as measured, the buttons from a DS Lite faceplate.

name: Deck inserts
desc: Each end's deck becomes its own printed insert (one part fits both ends), held by the end screws; the cell's plug hole moves past J2.

name: DS Lite shell
desc: A DS Lite style shell: rounded back, 4.3 mm corners, the seam on the face, and the DS Lite button stack on silicone pads, under a one-piece lid.

name: Screen in a lid pocket
desc: After the first fit print: Start and Select for each seat, the screen dropped into a pocket in the lid, an S-curve step to the decks, no holes through the lid.

name: Cell under the board
desc: The 3.5 in board with the cell lengthwise on the tub's floor under it and the speaker beside it: 14.6 mm at the screen.

name: Cell on the board
desc: The first layout: a 3.5 in panel, with the cell lying on the board under the screen; 13.9 mm at the screen, 7.86 at the ends.
